name: strapi-ecs-deploy-cloudwatch
description: This repository demonstrates the deployment of a Strapi application using a **Blue/Green deployment strategy** on AWS. The setup leverages **Amazon ECS (Elastic Container Service)**, **AWS CodeDeploy**, and **GitHub Actions** for continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD). This guide walks through the process of Dockerizing the Strapi app, pushing the Docker image to **Amazon ECR**, and setting up a fully automated deployment pipeline that switches traffic between Blue and Green environments.
